title: ResearchTask
description: A durable task in a research run (PRD section 7). Only the Orchestrator transitions status; dependencies live in TaskDependency records.

run_id.description: Set once a run picks the task up.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key preventing duplicate execution of the same logical work.

checkpoint.description: Opaque resumable checkpoint written by the worker before crash points.

cache_refs.description: Cache entries this task depends on or produced.

result_ref.description: Reference to the normalized result record.

error_ref.description: Reference to the structured error record.
